extra_quotes: We perform photoluminescence spectroscopy (PL) to probe phonon-assisted momentum-indirect interlayer transitions in our terraced few-layer R-WSe2, as seen in Figure 1e.
We probe the low-energy exciton ℎ𝐼𝑋KΛ with photoluminescence spectroscopy (PL) while sweeping the field from negative to positive (forward) and positive to negative (backward).
We fit the energy shift within each polarization regime with the model 𝛥𝐸(𝐸𝑧)= −√𝑡0 2+(𝑒𝐸𝑧∙𝑑0)2 and plot as continuous lines.
The setup is time-limited by the resolution of the SPAD which is 50 ps.
